description: AICTIONBOT™ Catalog Checker by KULIC Advisory. Puts a supplier's new price list (catalog) next to the old one and returns what needs attention before it is loaded: increases per item against a threshold, hidden changes in unit, price unit or content, new and dropped items, duplicates, implausible prices, invalid EANs, and the weighted change and extra cost per year when annual quantities are given. Without an old list it checks the new list on its own. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Requests without sign-in are limited to 20 KB.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

new_list.description: New price list rows: article_no, description, price, unit, price_unit (price per how many units, default 1), content (e.g. sheets per pack), min_order, ean, currency.

old_list.description: Optional old price list in the same form, plus annual_quantity (per year, in sales units of the old list) to weight the change.

threshold_percent.description: Increase per item that needs a look, in percent. Default 5. Three times the threshold is a stop.

name: check_catalog
title: Check a supplier's new price list against the old one before loading it: increases per item, hidden unit changes, new and dropped items
